selection: Exactly the momentum top-decile holdings reconstructed from saved CSV scores with the original tie-break rule; no rescoring or replacement
volatility_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of 63 close-to-close returns from 64 contiguous XNYS closes ending at decision close
challenger: Weights proportional to inverse trailing volatility, capped at 2/N and proportionally redistributed; fully invested long only
fallback: If any selected name lacks a complete valid same-security volatility window, or volatility is zero/nonfinite, use equal weights for the entire basket and report the reason
cost_model: Same full round-trip charge on total invested notional for both weightings; no netting or volatility-dependent slippage assumption
missingness: Keep selected unresolved weights; never renormalize onto known outcomes. Also report paired adverse assignments from the frozen [-100%,+25%] scenarios
data_cutoff: Each input report's original system-observed and created-at cutoff, not today's latest prices
evaluation: Development and later splits unchanged. Report both samples and leave-best-difference-out sensitivity. No optimized weights, risk target, new sample, or live promotion
limitations: Same market dates already examined; not independent temporal validation
Inverse-volatility weighting can increase dollar concentration relative to equal weight
Period-boundary drawdown is not intraperiod drawdown
Weighted-volatility proxy is not covariance-based risk contribution
Price-return diagnostic excludes dividends and realistic capacity/slippage; preserve prior identity and event-sensitivity caveats
